note: Monthly long-only factor portfolio. Decision uses information through the last session of the month (F); orders fill at the first session of the next month (M) open. Everything below is fixed before the first run; changes require a new version/experiment id.

bp.desc: book equity (latest 자본총계, CFS preferred) / market cap

ep.desc: TTM 당기순이익 (sum of last 4 quarterly 3-month figures) / market cap

lowvol.desc: std of daily close returns over last 120 sessions

composite: equal-weighted average of cross-sectional percentile ranks (missing factor -> stock excluded)
weighting: equal weight, full rebalance to target at M open
rebalance: first session of each calendar month
corporate_actions: listed-share-count changes >=1.5x or <=0.67x applied to holdings at the matching price-gap date (ex-date) or the share-change date
delisting: position exits at the last session with a bar (정리매매 included) at that close
risk_filter: negative book equity excluded; no other financial-risk review (label runs accordingly)
